cap: A red, swollen scrotum has more causes than torsion. Epididymitis follows the patient's age: chlamydia and gonorrhea under about 35, and Escherichia coli in older men or after urinary instrumentation. Mumps orchitis swells the testis inside the inelastic tunica albuginea, so pressure kills tubules. The cremasteric reflex runs through the genitofemoral nerve and is absent in torsion but present in these other causes.
